entity_raw.source_book_raw: Pathfinder Player Companion: Heroes of the High Court
entity_raw.definition_raw:
You receive a small allowance from your noble family or inheritance.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, Noble Scion.

Benefit(s): You receive 100 gp at the beginning of every week that you can spend only on services and nonmaterial goods.

Services and nonmaterial goods include the following.

Hiring entertainers, messengers, mounts, servants, transport, workers, and so on.Improving your lifestyle quality (see Cost of Living).Obtaining invitations to exclusive events or entry into privileged locations.Paying for lodgings, stabling, taxes, and tolls.
